english.title: Left a vehicle unattended with the engine running / an ignition key in the vehicle on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..), without the permission of Heathrow Airport Limited, left a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[unattended while its engine was running]_
(B)_[with a removable ignition key unattended when the ignition key was in the vehicle]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.4 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Transport Act 1986.
